thing.name: seven useless moons in a shallow bowl
thing.body:
A shallow blue-glass bowl on the windowsill holds seven moons, each no larger than a plum.

None matches the sky. One is striped like a peppermint. One has a tiny door painted on it that cannot open. One is covered in soft green fuzz. One changes from silver to pink whenever nobody describes it. One is plainly made of folded paper. One appears to be asleep. The seventh reflects a room that does not exist.

They provide no light, forecast no tide, unlock no mechanism, prove no claim, and improve nothing measurable.

They are here because seven useless moons looked beautiful in a bowl.
